description: Small-field beam profile (Excel): relative dose vs off-axis position -20..20 mm for a 15-mm circular field, SciFi detector as blue dots (one every 0.2 mm, 10 px, merging into a band on the flat top) and EBT3 film as a noisy thin orange line; the two series nearly coincide. L-shaped axes (no frame): outward majors every 5 mm below the X axis and inward minors every 1 mm above it; outward majors at 0.5 / 1 left of the Y axis and inward minors every 0.1 right of it (the Y axis ends at 1.1). A legend entry "EBT3 film" sits inside the plot area at the right. Journal figure (Pittet et al. 2020, Med Phys 47(4):1930, Fig. 8 panel b without the thumbnails and the "(b)" caption; crop x 0-1264, y 1008-1944 of the publisher's 2128x3053 JPEG, re-encoded with the source quantization tables), 1264x936 JPEG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the X axis line (black, 1 px core + 2 antialiased rows) at relative dose 0. Outward majors (~9 px) at -20..20 every 5 mm (the -20 one is the Y axis line continuing below), inward marks (~6 px) every 1 mm above the line; the inward marks at |x| >= 13 mm are hidden under the SciFi dots lying on the axis, so only -12 ... 12 are labelled as minors.

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the Y axis line (black, ~2 px). Outward majors left of it at 0.5 and 1 (0 is the X axis continuing to the left), inward marks right of it every 0.1 up to 1.1, where the axis ends. Labels "0", "0.5", "1".

pitfalls: Negative X: labels -20, -15, -10, -5 with hyphen-like minus signs; the Y axis is at the left edge (-20 mm), not at 0.
The SciFi dots lie on the X axis line for |x| > 13 mm and hide its inward minor ticks there.
Two near-identical series: blue dots and a thin orange line cross each other all along the profile and on the flat top.
Legend entry "EBT3 film" (orange line sample, two lines of text) inside the plot area at the right (orange sample from column ~1045, text columns 1086-1156, rows 460-528).
Majors outward, minors inward on both axes (Excel "cross"-like mix); the Y axis ends at 1.1 with a minor mark.
Re-encoded JPEG (artifacts around the dots and text).
